name: 79-candidate source and gene-trait acceptance matrix
context: Governed review of batches 01-08, not a new strain cohort
metadata_source: existing research files from PR 160 exact branch

evidence_definition.A_referenced_breeding_stock_cross: Japanese source reports population source mating or crossed breeding stocks. Does not identify exact parent fish, individual genetics, reproduction ratio or independent genotype.
evidence_definition.B_family_selection_or_phenotype_relation: Historical selection/source family asserted, but specific two-stock founding mating is not resolved.
evidence_definition.C_phenotype_only_origins_unreported: Catalog identifies characteristic (possibly breeder or year), no source-supported founder pair/relationship in prior research intake.

critical_rules: A score is not independent corroboration. Most of these are single specialist records or reprints of a breeder account.
Every record requires alias and previous unstructured-research reconciliation before it is counted as a distinct verified cultivar.
JMA recognition numbers and WEB Zukan species numbers are different sources; do not treat catalog numbering as official recognition.
No commercial allele has been directly genotyped; never assign 'dominant' or 'recessive' based solely on line stability/fixation.
Do not publish imagery without original creator's licensed permission.
Do not merge, publish or Discord-sync PR 160 without independent governed clearance and owner authorization.
